violations.text: Quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution was in excess of 400 parts per million (ppm). A quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength as indicated on the manufacturers' label. Per PIC, sink and surface bottle is normally sent over from high school. Since bottle has been used, quaternary ammonium solution was being used from janitors chemical dispenser. Dispenser was dispensing quaternary ammonium solution above 400ppm. Whichever sanitizer solution is being used must be within proper ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026
